statusKey.confirmed: Dates and venue checked against the organizer's own website or documents.
statusKey.reported: Dates published by several independent listings but not yet checked on the organizer's site. Confirm with the organizer before booking.
statusKey.unannounced: The organizer has not published dates for this edition yet.

events.name: SEMA Show 2026
events.description: The specialty automotive aftermarket's trade show: custom vehicles, performance parts, accessories, and education for shops, distributors, and manufacturers. Trade-only, with public access on the final day.
events.notes: Organizer lists the Friday as the only day open to the general public.

events.name: AAPEX 2026
events.description: Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo, a business-to-business show for parts suppliers, distributors, retailers, and repair shops. Runs the same week as SEMA.

events.name: AWS re:Invent 2026
events.description: Amazon Web Services' annual cloud and AI conference, with keynotes, technical sessions, labs, and a partner expo spread across several Strip properties.
events.notes: Published listings name Caesars Forum, Caesars Palace, Encore, MGM Grand, The Venetian, and Wynn among the venues. Check the organizer's venue page for the final list.

events.name: MJBizCon 2026
events.description: Business conference and expo for the cannabis industry, covering cultivation, manufacturing, retail, compliance, and investment.

events.name: LDI Show 2026
events.venue: Las Vegas Convention Center, West Hall
events.description: The live entertainment technology show: lighting, audio, video, staging, rigging, and special effects, with a week of hands-on training before the expo floor opens.
events.notes: Training runs December 2–8; the expo floor is open December 6–8. LDI moves to New Orleans for 2027.

events.name: CES 2027
events.venue: Las Vegas Convention Center and other official venues
events.description: The Consumer Technology Association's annual show for consumer electronics, AI, mobility, smart home, and digital health, spread across the LVCC, Venetian, and C Space campuses.
events.notes: Trade-only event. Exhibits span the LVCC, Venetian, and C Space campuses.

events.name: World of Concrete 2027
events.description: Annual international show for commercial concrete and masonry construction, with indoor and outdoor exhibits, live equipment demonstrations, and an education program.

events.name: SHOT Show 2027
events.description: Trade show for the shooting sports, hunting, outdoor, and law enforcement industries, organized by the National Shooting Sports Foundation. Not open to the public.

events.name: MAGIC Las Vegas (February 2027)
events.description: Fashion trade event for apparel, footwear, and accessories brands and buyers, held alongside PROJECT and SOURCING at MAGIC.

events.name: NAB Show 2027
events.venue: Las Vegas Convention Center (West, Central and North Halls)
events.description: The National Association of Broadcasters' show for broadcast, streaming, production, and media technology.

events.name: ISC West 2027
events.description: Security industry conference and expo covering video surveillance, access control, alarms, connected IoT, and public safety technology.

events.name: JCK Las Vegas 2027
events.description: The jewelry industry's major U.S. trade show for manufacturers, designers, watch brands, and retail buyers.

events.name: Black Hat USA 2027
events.description: Information security conference with trainings, research briefings, and a business hall for security vendors.

events.name: PACK EXPO Las Vegas 2027
events.venue: Las Vegas Convention Center (West, North, Central and South Lower Halls)
events.description: Packaging and processing machinery show with live equipment on the floor. Held in Las Vegas every other year.

events.name: AAPEX 2027
events.description: Next edition of the Automotive Aftermarket Products Expo.
events.notes: Dates come from a third-party future-dates listing. Venue not yet confirmed.

events.name: SEMA Show 2027
events.description: Next edition of the SEMA Show. We will add dates once SEMA publishes them.

events.name: NAB Show 2028
events.description: Media and broadcast technology show from the National Association of Broadcasters.
events.notes: Listed by the organizer as a save-the-date.

events.name: CinemaCon 2027
events.description: Official convention of Cinema United, the movie theater owners' association: studio presentations in The Colosseum, seminars, and a cinema equipment and concessions trade show.
events.notes: The trade show floor runs on fewer days than the full convention. Check the exhibitor FAQ for 2027 floor dates.

events.name: HD Expo + Conference 2027
events.description: Hospitality design trade show and conference for designers, architects, and hotel and restaurant owners sourcing furniture, lighting, and finishes.
events.notes: Education day May 3; expo hall open May 4–5 only. Some third-party listings still show the old May 4–6 dates.
